text:
Weekend closures set for Makawao Avenue as reconstruction project enters third phase
U. N. Kim
The County of Maui Department of Public Works announced on July 29 that the third phase of paving for the Makawao Avenue Reconstruction project will begin Saturday, Aug. 1, and continue through Sunday, Aug. 16, 2026. The work will require weekend closures of both lanes on sections of Makawao Avenue, with motorists and pedestrians advised to expect delays and follow all traffic-control personnel, posted signs, and detour routes.
Weekend construction is scheduled from 6 a.m. Saturday to 6:30 p.m. Sunday during this period. Full road closures will be in effect in certain areas, but access will remain available for local traffic only.
The planned weekend construction dates and affected areas are as follows: August 1-2 from Makani Road to Eddie Tam Memorial Center; August 8-9 from Eddie Tam Memorial Center to Maha Road; and August 15-16 from Makani Road to Maha Road. These dates are subject to change.
The overall reconstruction project covers approximately 1.8 miles from Apana Road to Ai Street. Ongoing weekday construction between Apana Road and Ai Street continues with single lane closures in active work zones between the hours of 8:30 a.m. and 3 p.m.
According to the Department of Public Works, the first two phases—covering Apana Road to Makani Road—were completed recently. The entire DPW project began in October 2025 and is expected to finish by February 2027, with improvements including pavement reconstruction, sidewalk, curb and drainage upgrades, guardrail replacement, as well as new striping and signage.
For more information about the Department of Public Works or updates on this project, residents can visit www.mauicounty.gov/publicworks.
